Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1100); worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan:--Belial.
BiblicalUsage: Belial carries the plain sense of worthlessness, and it shows up only once, in 2 Corinthians 6:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Belial is a small window into a bigger truth, and I am glad it is there.
